name: Richard Uihlein

lean.basis: Gives almost only to Republicans and conservative groups, often the insurgent hard right: Ted Cruz and Scott Walker in 2016, then Trump; Club for Growth; Restoration PAC, his own super PAC, which ran over $34M of ads against Kamala Harris in 2024. The Washington Post says the couple have helped push the party further right.

current_role: Co-founder and chairman of Uline; Republican megadonor and main funder of Restoration of America PAC
summary: Richard "Dick" Uihlein co-founded the shipping-supplies company Uline with his wife Elizabeth in 1980; she is its CEO and he is chairman. The couple were the fourth-largest donors of 2024 and second only to Elon Musk in 2026, mostly through Restoration of America PAC, which he almost single-handedly funds, and Wisconsin Republican causes.
